svg.aria-label: What I build. Web products for businesses: Online stores with B2B dealer portals and online payments, admin panels, CRMs and multilingual corporate websites. Desktop software: Keymotion: a free, open-source Windows app for controlling a mechanical keyboard. Rust, Tauri 2 and React. Hosting and operations: Linux servers, deployments, backups, monitoring and security updates, long after launch.
